about.title: About
about.body1: Driven by a lifelong fascination with light and perception, my work exists at the boundary between the seen and the felt. Each canvas is an attempt to crystallise a fleeting moment — the quality of afternoon light through a window, the weight of silence in an empty room.
about.body2: Working primarily in oils and mixed media, I explore the tension between precision and spontaneity, building layers that reward sustained looking. The paintings are never finished so much as abandoned at the right moment.
about.body3: Based in Canada, my work has been exhibited across North America and Europe. Commissions and inquiries are welcome.
